industry.why: Neutral, carried, with the evidence moved towards the tape. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): third-quarter beats were sold (Sandvik down 5%, Atlas Copco down 8%, Hiab down 12%), Danske Bank's C-J (25 October) says 'a lot is priced in' with the order strength coming from data centres the market no longer pays for, and the exception is the non-AI compounder (Hexagon, 13% organic growth); against it, offshore services and nuclear have multi-year visibility and electrical equipment is still the physical bottleneck. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: D now, C prior. The sector rows do the work: Electrical equipment, Diversified groups, Distributors, Test and measurement and Engineered components at C, Flow control and Building technology at D. Five live holdings (19.35 points of the book) sit here, judged in component 4. Counter-case for D: a tape that sells beats is a regime statement; for B: the order data remain the strongest non-AI demand read in the pack. To D on a second week of beats sold with relative strength falling to F.

sector.why: Neutral, set deliberately this week (carried C). Component 1 regime, 16-Oct-26 (a discount-rate shock with the first credit crack inside the artificial intelligence chain: United States core inflation re-accelerating on energy, the Fed and Bank of England hikes pulled forward, the US 10-year about 5.1%, the US joined the sell-off and Asia is in washout, defensives bid for four weeks in Europe, European breadth off its three-year lows but in the bottom quarter, the consumer forecast to weaken into winter; sources present 2026-W42): diversified industrial groups are cyclical capital goods into a growth scare, but their diversification is itself the simple, proven profile the regime pays for, and Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-16 against 2026-08-14, not week on week: A now, C prior, says the market is paying for it. Three memos this week in this Sector all turn on the Fragility axis, not on the Sector: Beijer Alma (Mixed) and Idun Industrier (Fights it) are small, geared, re-rating-dependent Swedish acquirers, thyssenkrupp (Mixed) is large but 'neither simple nor proven'; the Fragility row carries that judgement, so the Sector row does not double it. One live holding, Sdiptech (5.05%, Sell-side and Thematic Fit A). Counter-case for higher: leadership and six MI Pool names with Thematic Fit B; for lower: the group's small acquirers are what a credit crack hurts first. Neutral by judgement.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No Swedish survey and no Riksbank reading reached the pack this week, so the condition for B (a confidence print at or above normal with the Riksbank on hold) could not be tested; the only Swedish data point is food retail volumes up 5.3% in September after a value-added tax cut (Danske, 18 Oct), which is a sector fact, not a country view. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Four live holdings are Swedish (Avanza 0.50%, Hexatronic 4.95%, Sdiptech 5.05%, Xvivo 5.05%, 15.55 points), judged in component 4 and in amendment 10. Relative strength is not graded by country.

memo.verdict: Neutral; park; conviction medium on the analysis and low on the timing. Idun Industrier (IDUN.B-SE) is an oversold compounder with a transient cause for concern, not a recovery case and not a demand inflection. At SEK 320 the modal total shareholder return is about 16% a year over eighteen months (16.2%) and 14% a year over three years (14.0%), inside the framework's C band and short of the 20% bar. The gate line does not park the case (management B, business quality C, predictability B, trackability C); the return and the risk at this price do. Progress trigger: the price at or below about SEK 305 with the Q3 2026 report (23 October 2026) showing Service & Maintenance organic EBITA no worse and group organic sales at the broker's 3%; or a positive organic EBITA quarter at any price up to about SEK 340. Invalidate: a deal above 9x EBITA; leverage above 3.0x at a year-end; an earn-out reversal, an impairment or a departure from the parent team; a minority share of profit above 25% in the 2026 accounts. Practical constraint: at SEK 2.3m a day of trading a position of size would take weeks to build and longer to leave.
case: - The change moving the numbers is internal and financial and already in the accounts: seven acquisitions since November 2025 after a pause of more than a year, adding about SEK 50m a year of EBITDA from three at margins above the group's; the SEK 220m bond redeemed on 30 June 2026 saving SEK 8m a year on top of the SEK 20m a year the 2025 refinancing saved. Adjusted EPS rises from SEK 13.90 (FY2025) to about SEK 17.0 (FY2026) and SEK 19.1 (FY2027) whatever organic demand does; consensus FY2026 EPS rose 24.8% in twelve months and the rise is roll-in, not organic beats.

- The change that would make the case compelling is external and has not reached the company: the purchasing managers' index at 56 to 58.1 and order books improving at about half the subsidiaries, against organic sales +0.7% and organic EBITA -7.7% in Q2 2026 and management's own 2027 date. The weakness is named and local (LMI's storm-delayed root-rot products; Stegaföretagen against exceptional 2025 car-wash volumes; P&L Nordic's training budgets; ILEMA's pulp-and-paper customers); heavy-industry maintenance (Triton, Ståthöga) and Manufacturing are growing; cohort peers already grow organically, so the divergence is partly mix and partly company.

- 'Financial Outputs' improve on the headline and deteriorate underneath: revenue +14.1% in H1 2026 and EPS growth inside or above the 12% to 20% band on all three horizons from today's trailing base (about +27% over six months, 18% a year over eighteen months, 14.6% a year over three years), but about 10% a year on the forward run-rate from FY2028; cash conversion 77% to 59%, working capital 29.3% of trailing revenue, net debt to EBITDA 1.8x to 2.8x in six quarters. The engine is throttled by management's "somewhat slower" guidance; the framework's conditional rule for continuation is only half met.
counter_case: Idun is a "false friend": a serial acquirer whose reported quality (60% gross margins, over-50% niche shares, co-owning managers, a 30%-a-year EBITA record from 2020 to 2025) masks an organic engine that has shrunk for six quarters, a parent that owns 85% of the EBITA and converts 59% of it to cash, a balance sheet at 2.8x to 3.4x against a 3.5x covenant with about 1.0x of minority options outside it, an eight-person centre that would see a subsidiary failure after it has happened, and a crowded Swedish deal market at 8x to 10x EBITDA that forces the group either to overpay or to stop. The engine stalls at the ceiling just as the organic weakness proves structural (the earnings review's own "other side": the organic slowdown may solidify into a structural downturn); the sole broker's fair-value range keeps falling (four cuts in 2026); and on 7,274 shares a day the price goes to the bear path's SEK 313 or the stress case's SEK 269, with no buyer of size on the other side. The evidence for it is real and carried: organic EBITA -3.7% in FY2025 and -3.6% in H1 2026 against a 2020-2025 organic record of +9% a year; the gross margin down 170 basis points in H1 2026; cash conversion from 77% to 59%; working capital at 29.3% of revenue; leverage from 1.8x to 2.8x in six quarters; the sector evidence of late-surfacing failures at small-centred peers (Teqnion's SEK 73m impairment with nine central staff and no internal audit; Storskogen's SEK 30m fraud across 124 units). A reader who refuses the K3 add-backs sees a levered group whose 8.4% reported return on capital is below its cost of bank debt plus a micro-cap equity premium, trading at 68x reported earnings. The whole is a collection of individually tolerable weaknesses that is fatal in combination: a SEK 3.7bn micro-cap, 45% free float, 79% of votes with the founder, one sponsored broker, leverage near a covenant, 15% minority leakage, K3 accounts, an eight-person centre, six quarters of organic decline; if the organic turn does not arrive by 2027 the exit is slow and the lender, not the shareholder, sets the pace.

Conceded: the engine is throttled for the next twelve months and the broker's path, not ours, is the one the market will read; Service & Maintenance is a structural question until a positive organic quarter answers it; the combination is the reason the 'Investment Case' is a D; a concentrated holder cannot leave this stock quickly; the subsidiary-failure risk is real. Response: the 2026 earnings growth is contractual or already consolidated; the niche structure held its gross margin through the whole 2023-2025 slowdown, which a false friend's would not; the prices paid (6x to 8x) are the cohort's good half and the discount tracks what was paid; the operator's response (pause, deleverage, refinance, cluster, slow again) is what a disciplined owner does; none of the layers is deteriorating; and the competing hypothesis's own price, SEK 313, is 2% below where the shares already are, so the market has priced the false friend and not the compounder. Where the case against would win: Service & Maintenance organic EBITA still falling in Q3 or Q4 2026 while the purchasing managers' index stays above 55 (execution, not cycle); a second weak organic quarter together with leverage above 3.0x. The bound on the downside is the multiple at its floor, 14x on three earnings bases, SEK 274 to SEK 312. The setup counter-case, that this is an early 'Trough on Trough' or 'Major CfC Clearing' that has not yet capitulated, is conceded on the sell-side and answered on the price (the 2nd percentile; -23.7% relative) and on the fact that there is almost no sell-side to cut and no annual guidance to rebase.
triggers: - Q3 2026 report, 23 October 2026: the first chance at a positive organic EBITA quarter; the broker expects adjusted EBITA +22% year on year, 18% acquired sales growth, 3% organic. Service & Maintenance organic EBITA no worse and group organic sales at 3%, with the price at or below about SEK 305, moves the case to progress; Service & Maintenance still falling with the purchasing managers' index above 55 says execution, and we move the organic turn from probable to possible.
- A positive organic EBITA quarter at any price up to about SEK 340 moves the case to progress.
- Year-end report, early March 2027: the test of the "margins up in 2026" guide (about 14.0% needed) and the first word on 2027.

- Monitoring milestones: Service & Maintenance organic EBITA positive by Q1 2027 (invalidate if still negative); group organic EBITA at least +5% by Q4 2026; net debt to EBITDA below 3.0x at year-end 2026 trending to 2.5x (alarm above 3.0x at a quarter end; invalidate above 3.0x at a year-end); two further deals by mid-2027 below 8x EBITA (alarm above 8x; invalidate above 9x); cash conversion back above 60% for FY2026; the minority share of adjusted profit staying below 25% in the 2026 accounts.
- Invalidate: an earn-out reversal, an impairment, a restatement or a departure from the parent team.
- The rates squeeze: Addtech and Lagercrantz below 20x would cap the cleared branch nearer 16x than 18x.
